THIS VIRGINIA RULING IS BULLSHIT
....and I explain exactly why here 
statehouseaction.substack.com/p/may-dazed

Four VA Supreme Court justices decided to ignore the definition of election in constitution & code.
Article IV, Sec. 3: “the Tuesday succeeding the first Monday in November.”
§ 24.2-101: "'General election' means an election held in the Commonwealth on the Tuesday after the first Monday in November"

State statutes permitting early voting are dependent on the specific definition of "election." Four Virginia Supreme Court justices absolutely decided to engage in partisan hackery in a way I've never seen before in the Commonwealth.

The three dissenting justices have the goods:
"...today the majority has broadened the meaning of the word 'election,' as used in the Virginia Constitution, to include the early voting period.  This is in direct conflict with how both Virginia and federal law define an election."

One must fully understand that the Virginia Supreme Court ruling is not simply overruling the voters based on a technicality--it is overruling the voters on a technicality THAT THEY LITERALLY JUST INVENTED FOR THIS PURPOSE AND EXISTS NOWHERE ELSE IN VIRGINIA OR FEDERAL LAW
